detached_structure.evidence: A small dark-roofed structure sits to the right of the driveway at the top center, near the parked car. It could be a garage or shed, but it may belong to the neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The house is heavily shaded by dense mature tree canopy, with a reddish-brown roof partly obscured by trees and a flat-roofed section on the lower right. One car is parked on the driveway at the top, and the yard is mostly hidden by trees.
